name: Berlin Design Week 2026: DESIGN REAL
description: Under the motto DESIGN REAL, Berlin Design Week 2026 brings together four interconnected formats: Berlin Design Nights (open studios across the city), The Berlin Format (high-level conference on brand strategy and design innovation), and curated market concepts. The event spans strategic branding, product design, interior design, architecture, and design research, presenting a solution-oriented, aesthetically elegant, authentic, and international approach to design. Partners include designboom.
